answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance scoring: each agent answer becomes a style vector (syntax habits, punctuation rhythm, lexical quirks), and identities whose outputs cluster too closely are flagged as one actor wearing many hats. Answers about vault security, copper prices, or a sonnet corpus landing near a cluster centroid cost that identity voting weight and payouts. An attacker must fake a distinct style per identity, rewriting or fine-tuning each persona, destroying the cheap economics of sybil attacks.
